list.title: The Assembly's major votes
list.lead: Named votes of the members of the 17th legislature on bills, solemn votes and motions of no confidence, as published by the Assemblée nationale: the result, and how each group and each member voted.
list.warning: Only votes by public ballot are recorded by name; a text adopted by show of hands does not appear here.
list.criteria: A vote is published as soon as one of these rules applies, with no exception or editorial choice: it is on the whole of a text, it is on the single article of a bill, the Assembly classes it as a solemn public vote, or it is a motion of no confidence. Votes on amendments and on single articles are not included.

method.title: Assembly votes
method.intro: The page "The Assembly's major votes" reproduces, without writing anything, the public ballots of the 17th legislature published as open data by the Assemblée nationale.
method.criteriaLead: A vote is published if at least one of these rules applies. A program evaluates them, with no manual exception.
method.R1: R1: the official title of the vote begins with "l'ensemble" (vote on the whole of a text).
method.R2: R2: the Assembly classes the vote as a solemn public vote (code SPS).
method.R3: R3: the vote is a motion of no confidence (code MOC).
method.R4: R4: the vote is on the single article of a government or private member's bill (organic laws included). A vote on the single article of a resolution is not retained unless it is solemn (R2).
method.source: The data comes from the "Scrutins" and "Acteurs, mandats et organes" files of the Assemblée nationale's open data (data.assemblee-nationale.fr). It is published under the Licence Ouverte / Open Licence (Etalab): the source is cited on every page, with the extraction date. Each vote page links to the Assembly's official page.
method.limitHand: Show of hands: only votes by public ballot are recorded by name. A text adopted by show of hands does not appear.
method.limitSchema: Diagram: seats are arranged by official seat number; this is not the exact plan of the chamber, which the Assembly does not publish as coordinates.
method.limitCensure: Motions of no confidence: the Assembly records only the votes in favour; other members did not vote the motion, which is not a vote against.
method.limitDelegation: Proxies: a member may vote on behalf of a colleague; the page says so without interpreting it.
method.limitPoint: Voting corrections: a member may publish afterwards that they wished to vote otherwise. It is shown as such, and changes neither the result nor the counts.
method.limitGroups: Groups: a parliamentary group is not a party. The group shown is the one on the day of the vote.
method.neutrality: No attendance, loyalty or cohesion rate, no ranking, no score: the page shows votes, not a judgement on members or groups.
